notes.title: Astero Inc. on sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250023/275e89f87c61918a0673272a9fb281e9069b03bc.png[/img]

Hello Miners!

We just wanted to let you know that Astero Inc. will be on sale for a limited time, so run! Those asteroids aren't going to mine themselves!

We hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: New languages, accessibility and minor fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250023/7cddf49c8e9f7e2579da0a9a9a208d6ad329a666.jpg[/img]

Hello miners!

The work on Astero Inc. continues, and as said, we added two new language regions to enjoy the game: French and German. You can change them in the main menu.

In this version 1.0.5 we want to help all miners by adding more information to consult, to better learn the basics of the game. You can access them from the town hall application on the game desktop or from the asteroid itself, in the [b]options menu[/b].

In addition, minor UI issues have been fixed.

We are still working hard on Astero Inc. We will have more news soon!

notes.title: Roadmap and new aspects of development
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250023/275e89f87c61918a0673272a9fb281e9069b03bc.png[/img]

Hello miners!

We want to share with you a brief roadmap of what's to come in Astero Inc. We have several major updates planned, as well as several smaller updates that will be arriving over the coming months.

First, we want to get Astero Inc. into as many languages as possible. Very soon, the game will be localized in German, French, Italian and Portuguese, while we are still working on a second batch of languages - stay tuned for updates!

Regarding the social aspect, we have always wanted to include a more "real" mining competition, where you will be able to measure your skills against other miners. Scorecards, weekly challenges, and more events are coming soon to Astero Inc. 

We haven't forgotten about achievements either. We want to add more variety and quantity, for the most dedicated miners.
